array nums = [5, 2, 4, 1]
n = nums.length
for i=0 to n - 2
    swapped = False
    for j=0 to n - 1 - i - 1
        if nums[j] > nums[j + 1] then
            // swap the two values using temp
            temp = nums[j]
            nums[j] = nums[j + 1]
            nums[j + 1] = temp
            swapped = True
        endif
    next j
    if NOT swapped then
        break  [!]
    endif
next i
print(nums)
